messages:
Alex: Quick sync — planning a small playbook for Datadog + OpenTelemetry traces for GPU inference (aim: partner demo & marketplace tile). Who can own trace schema + example dashboard?
Mira: I can take the dashboard wireframe. gonna reuse the per-model latency + KV cache hit panels.
Sam: I can own the trace schema and the OTLP collector config. want to keep spans lightweight (no heavy tensors).
Priya: Heads-up — marketing wants 2 screenshots and a short explainer for the announcement. Target draft by next Tue. :spiral_calendar_pad:
Luis: For SI partners, we should add a quick troubleshooting checklist: common sampler config, env vars, and GPU metrics. I can draft.
Alex: @Mira + @Sam + @Luis nice. Sam, add a sample collector config that points to Datadog OTLP endpoint. Keep it copy-paste friendly.
Sam: putting a snippet here — use the OTLP exporter + resource attrs
Sam: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: null
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:443"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "$DD_API_KEY"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Mira: For dashboard, thinking these widgets: 1) per-model p95 latency, 2) token throughput, 3) cache hit ratio, 4) sampled trace waterfall, 5) fallbacks by region. Will share Figma.
Priya: Can we include a short script to anonymize prompt text in traces? legal will ask.
Sam: yes — put only hash(prompt) as attribute, no raw prompt in spans. I'll add the hashing helper snippet.
Luis: I'll assemble the SI checklist + runbook: collector config, Env vars, common errors, Datadog dashboard import JSON, SLO suggestions.
integrations-bot: Auto-check: dashboard export looks good, schema passed basic lint (no PII fields detected). :white_check_mark:
Alex: Nice. Timeline: draft playbook + snippets by Fri EOD, Figma & dashboard by Mon, marketing draft by Tue. If blockers ping me.
Mira: tagging @priya for screenshots once dashboard is in.
Priya: noted. I'll prep copy and 2 short lines on value props.
Sam: I'll open a GH gist with config + hashing helper and link it here once ready.
Alex: Action items: Sam -> trace schema + gist, Mira -> dashboard JSON & figma, Luis -> SI runbook, Priya -> marketing draft. Owner + ETA in a little Google doc? I'll create one. :thumbsup:
Luis: quick question — should we include a small perf test script for 1-2 GPUs to reproduce numbers?
Mira: yes, small JMH-style script or K6 load with fixed prompts. keep it under 100 lines.
Alex: Agree. Add perf script to gist.
Priya: FYI — Partner comms needs privacy blurb (no raw prompts saved). Sam + Luis please add to doc.
Alex: Perfect. Thanks team — I'll post the Google doc link shortly and assign tasks.
__notes: Thread focused on Datadog + OpenTelemetry integration, dashboard and partner playbook. Short Slack-style messages, includes code snippet and bot message.
